lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੰ ਨਹ ਛੇਦੰਤ ਜਠਰ ਰੋਗਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jen kalaa maat garabh pratipaala(n) nah chheda(n)t jathar roganah ||
lines.translation: His Power provides nourishment in the womb of the mother, and does not let disease strike.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਨ ਕਲਾ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਸਰੋਵਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਛਿਜੰਤਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਤੋਯਣਹ ॥੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: ten kalaa asatha(n)bha(n) sarovara(n) naanak nah chhija(n)t tara(n)g toyanah ||53||
lines.translation: His Power holds back the ocean, O Nanak, and does not allow the waves of water to destroy the land. ||53||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਸਾਂਈ ਗਰਿਸ੍ਟ ਰੂਪੇਣ ਸਿਮਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਵਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gusaa(n)ee garist roopen simarana(n) sarabatr jeevanah ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the World is Supremely Beautiful; His Meditation is the Life of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬਧੵੰ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸ੍ਵਛ ਮਾਰਗ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਣਹ ॥੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: labadhy(n) sa(n)t sa(n)gen naanak svachh maarag har bhagatanah ||54||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, He is found on the path of devotional worship of the Lord. ||54||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਕੰ ਭਗਨੰਤ ਸੈਲੰ ਕਰਦਮੰ ਤਰੰਤ ਪਪੀਲਕਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: masaka(n) bhagana(n)t saila(n) karadama(n) tara(n)t papeelakah ||
lines.translation: The mosquito pierces the stone, the ant crosses the swamp,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਲੰਘੰਤਿ ਪਿੰਗੰ ਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਅੰਧਕਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: saagara(n) la(n)gha(n)t pi(n)ga(n) tam paragaas a(n)dhakah ||
lines.translation: the cripple crosses the ocean, and the blind sees in the darkness,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੫੫॥
lines.transliteration: saadh sa(n)gen simara(n)t gobi(n)d saran naanak har har hare ||55||
lines.translation: meditating on the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat. Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray. ||55||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲਕ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਬਿਪ੍ਰਾ ਅਮਰ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਰਾਜਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: tilak heena(n) jathaa bipraa amar heena(n) jathaa raajanah ||
lines.translation: Like a Brahmin without a sacred mark on his forehead, or a king without the power of command,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਧ ਹੀਣੰ ਜਥਾ ਸੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਰਮ ਹੀਣੰ ਤਥਾ ਬੈਸ੍ਨਵਹ ॥੫੬॥
lines.transliteration: aavadh heena(n) jathaa sooraa naanak dharam heena(n) tathaa baisnavah ||56||
lines.translation: or a warrior without weapons, so is the devotee of God without Dharmic Faith. ||56||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਸੰਖੰ ਨ ਚਕ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਗਦਾ ਨ ਸਿਆਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: na sa(n)kha(n) na chakra(n) na gadaa na siaama(n) ||
lines.translation: God has no conch-shell, no religious mark, no paraphernalia; he does not have blue skin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸ੍ਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੰ ਰਹੰਤ ਜਨਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ascharaj roopa(n) raha(n)t janama(n) ||
lines.translation: His Form is Wondrous and Amazing. He is beyond incarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕਥੰਤਿ ਬੇਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: net net katha(n)t bedaa ||
lines.translation: The Vedas say that He is not this, and not that.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooch mooch apaar gobi(n)dah ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is Lofty and High, Great and Infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਅਚੁਤ ਬੁਝੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਅਹ ॥੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: basa(n)t saadh ridaya(n) achut bujha(n)t naanak badabhaageeah ||57||
lines.translation: The Imperishable Lord abides in the hearts of the Holy. He is understood, O Nanak, by those who are very fortunate. ||57||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਿਆਨ ਬਸਨੰ ਸੰਸਾਰੰ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਸਿਆਲ ਖਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: udiaan basana(n) sa(n)saara(n) sanaba(n)dhee svaan siaal kharah ||
lines.translation: Living in the world, it is like a wild jungle. One's relatives are like dogs, jackals and donkeys.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਮਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਦਿਰੰ ਮਹਾਂ ਅਸਾਧ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikham sathaan man moh madira(n) mahaa(n) asaadh pa(n)ch tasakarah ||
lines.translation: In this difficult place, the mind is intoxicated with the wine of emotional attachment; the five unconquered thieves lurk there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਤ ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਣੰ ਅਹੰ ਫਾਂਸ ਤੀਖੵਣ ਕਠਿਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: heet moh bhai bharam bhramana(n) aha(n) phaa(n)s teekhyn kathinah ||
lines.translation: The mortals wander lost in love and emotional attachment, fear and doubt; they are caught in the sharp, strong noose of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਕ ਤੋਅ ਅਸਾਧ ਘੋਰੰ ਅਗਮ ਤੀਰ ਨਹ ਲੰਘਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: paavak to asaadh ghora(n) agam teer nah la(n)ghanah ||
lines.translation: The ocean of fire is terrifying and impassable. The distant shore is so far away; it cannot be reached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਉਧਰਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ॥੫੮॥
lines.transliteration: bhaj saadhasa(n)g goupaal naanak har charan saran udharan kripaa ||58||
lines.translation: Vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; O Nanak, by His Grace, we are saved at the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||58||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੰਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਸਗਲੵੰ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa kara(n)t gobi(n)d gopaalah sagaly(n) rog kha(n)danah ||
lines.translation: When the Lord of the Universe grants His Grace, all illnesses are cured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: saadh sa(n)gen gun ramat naanak saran pooran paramesurah ||59||
lines.translation: Nanak chants His Glorious Praises in the Saadh Sangat, in the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord God. ||59||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਆਮਲੰ ਮਧੁਰ ਮਾਨੁਖੵੰ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਭੂਮਿ ਵੈਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: siaamala(n) madhur maanukhy(n) ridaya(n) bhoom vairanah ||
lines.translation: The mortal is beautiful and speaks sweet words, but in the farm of his heart, he harbors cruel vengeance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਵੰਤਿ ਹੋਵੰਤਿ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚੇਤਨੰ ਸੰਤ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: niva(n)t hova(n)t mithiaa chetana(n) sa(n)t svajanah ||60||
lines.translation: He pretends to bow in worship, but he is false. Beware of him, O friendly Saints. ||60||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜਾ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤ ਘਟੰਤ ਸਾਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: achet mooRaa na jaana(n)t ghata(n)t saasaa nit prate ||
lines.translation: The thoughtless fool does not know that each day, his breaths are being used up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਿਜੰਤ ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕਾਲ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhija(n)t mahaa su(n)daree kaa(n)iaa kaal ka(n)niaa graasate ||
lines.translation: His most beautiful body is wearing away; old age, the daughter of death, has seized it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਲੀਲਾ ਅਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਨੋਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: racha(n)t purakhah kuta(n)b leelaa anit aasaa bikhiaa binod ||
lines.translation: He is engrossed in family play; placing his hopes in transitory things, he indulges in corrupt pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥੬੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhrama(n)t bhrama(n)t bahu janam haario saran naanak karunaa mayah ||61||
lines.translation: Wandering lost in countless incarnations, he is exhausted. Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Embodiment of Mercy. ||61||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਜਿਹਬੇ ਹੇ ਰਸਗੇ ਮਧੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੁਯੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: he jihabe he rasage madhur pri tuya(n) ||
lines.translation: O tongue, you love to enjoy the sweet delicacies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਹਤੰ ਪਰਮ ਬਾਦੰ ਅਵਰਤ ਏਥਹ ਸੁਧ ਅਛਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat hata(n) param baada(n) avarat ethah sudh achharanah ||
lines.translation: You are dead to the Truth, and involved in great disputes. Instead, repeat the holy words:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧਵੇ ॥੬੨॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d daamodar maadhave ||62||
lines.translation: Gobind, Daamodar, Maadhav. ||62||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੰਤਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਮਦੋਨ ਮਤੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: garaba(n)t naaree madon mata(n) ||
lines.translation: Those who are proud, and intoxicated with the pleasures of sex,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਵੰਤ ਬਲਾਤ ਕਾਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: balava(n)t balaat kaaranah ||
lines.translation: and asserting their power over others,

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਹ ਭਜੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜਨਮਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal nah bhaja(n)t trin samaan dhrig janamanah ||
lines.translation: never contemplate the Lord's Lotus Feet. Their lives are cursed, and as worthless as straw.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਪਪੀਲਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਸਟੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਤੁਯੰ ਧਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: he papeelakaa grasate gobi(n)d simaran tuya(n) dhane ||
lines.translation: You are as tiny and insignificant as an ant, but you shall become great, by the Wealth of the Lord's Meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਨਮੋ ਨਮਹ ॥੬੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak anik baar namo namah ||63||
lines.translation: Nanak bows in humble worship, countless times, over and over again. ||63||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣੰ ਤ ਮੇਰੰ ਸਹਕੰ ਤ ਹਰੀਅੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: trina(n) ta mera(n) sahaka(n) ta hareea(n) ||
lines.translation: The blade of grass becomes a mountain, and the barren land becomes green.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਡੰ ਤ ਤਰੀਅੰ ਊਣੰ ਤ ਭਰੀਅੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: booda(n) ta tareea(n) oona(n) ta bhareea(n) ||
lines.translation: The drowning one swims across, and the empty is filled to overflowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਉਜਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhakaar kot soor ujaara(n) ||
lines.translation: Millions of suns illuminate the darkness,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਯਾਰੰ ॥੬੪॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak har gur dayaara(n) ||64||
lines.translation: prays Nanak, when the Guru, the Lord, becomes Merciful. ||64||
